headline: Mrs Radhika Khurana resigns as Company Secretary of Xchanging Solutions
summary: Xchanging Solutions Limited has announced that Mrs Radhika Khurana will step down from her role as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective December 16, 2026. The company has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding this upcoming management change. For retail shareholders, executive departures in compliance roles are routine administrative transitions rather than fundamental business shifts. Such regulatory filings have minimal immediate impact on the company's daily operations or financial performance.
whats_next: Appointment of a new Compliance Officer by December 16, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine compliance change with no financial impact.
